Name: (CP) Potted Mushrooms
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Now that I know how to use Content Patcher to make furniture, I wanted to convert my '[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24839]Potted Mushrooms[/url]' mod to use it.

Just like that one, it adds some potted mushrooms (and empty pots) to the game as furniture you can place! You can find it in the furniture catalogue (or I think randomly from Robin)

I hope you enjoy :]

[b][i][center]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/center][/i][/b]
